tamborine-mountain-1.bio: A 1.5 km rainforest walk with 300 m of canopy bridges and a 40 m cantilever bridge over Cedar Creek.

tamborine-mountain-2.bio: A purpose-built cave at Cedar Creek Estate, where 30-minute guided daytime tours show native glow worms.

tamborine-mountain-3.bio: A short Grade 3 rainforest walk in Tamborine National Park to a waterfall over basalt columns.

scenic-rim-6.bio: A 40 m plunge waterfall in Main Range National Park, with a 2 km circuit and picnic area.
